fusions.name: Fang Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Venom Payoff
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 60% of their remaining damage per affliction to this blow, which deals 16 damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Coiled Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Swallow
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
